  681 #===============================================================================
  682 # Target's last move used loses 3 PP. Damaging move. (Eerie Spell)
  683 #===============================================================================
  684 class Battle::Move::LowerPPOfTargetLastMoveBy3 < Battle::Move
  685   def pbAdditionalEffect(user, target)
  686     return if target.fainted? || target.damageState.substitute
  687     last_move = target.pbGetMoveWithID(target.lastRegularMoveUsed)
  688     return if !last_move || last_move.pp == 0 || last_move.total_pp <= 0
  689     reduction = [3, last_move.pp].min
  690     target.pbSetPP(last_move, last_move.pp - reduction)
  691     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It reduced the PP of {1}'s {2} by {3}!",
